hookups.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/blue-knob-state-park/stay ('Most sites have electric service') + ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880302 (25 public sites list 50-amp, 21 list 30-amp, 3 20-amp), read 2026-10-20

values.note: DCNR: '50 tent and trailer sites ... Two sites are walk-in only', in open fields and woods. The booking site lists 47 electric and 2 non-electric campsites; listed max vehicle length is 30 ft at most sites, 40 ft at four (15, 47, 48, 49), and about six are pull-through.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/blue-knob-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880302 (site list and each site's details page) + the DCNR stay page, read 2026-10-20

values.note: The booking page lists the nearest camp store and laundromat as outside the campground.

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/blue-knob-state-park/stay ('Water, a sanitary dump station, modern restrooms') + ReserveAmerica Services and Amenities for parkId 880302 (Bath House, Hot Showers, Sanitation Dumping Station Is Available In The Campground, Nearest Camp Store Outside The Campground, Nearest Laundromat Outside Of Campground), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campsites can be booked up to 11 months ahead and for the same day (ReserveAmerica booking window).

booking.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/blue-knob-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880302 (Booking Window: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window for this park; season (second Friday in April to mid-October) already manual. Added 50-amp electric, 49 campsites to 40 ft with a few pull-throughs, hot showers, water, dump, no camp store or laundry on site. Not stated for this park: water/sewer at sites, min/max stay, noon cutoff, fcfs. Fees left as recorded.
